class.name: SteamTimeline
class.brief_description: Submits gameplay markers and phases to Steam Game Recording.
class.description: Submits gameplay markers and phases to Steam Game Recording. Get the service from [method SteamClient.timeline]. Markers belong to the issuing facade. The process can have one open phase. A submitted marker does not guarantee footage. Use the recording queries to check for footage.

method.name: add_phase_tag
method.description: Adds a tag to the current phase owned by this facade. An empty group leaves the tag out of group filtering. Priority ranges from 0 through 1000.

method.name: clear_tooltip
method.description: Clears the process timeline tooltip at the given relative time in seconds.

method.name: end_phase
method.description: Closes the active game phase if this facade owns it.

method.name: end_range
method.description: Ends an open range owned by this service at a relative time in seconds.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the active main-thread scope can use Steam Timeline.

method.name: mark
method.description: Adds an instantaneous marker. A null options object selects the default icon, priority, clip policy, and start time.

method.name: mark_range
method.description: Marks a fixed duration greater than zero and at most 600 seconds.

method.name: open_in_overlay
method.description: Requests the overlay view of an event owned by this facade. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] if the overlay is disabled or still starting.

method.name: open_phase_in_overlay
method.description: Requests that an enabled Steam overlay open the phase associated with this game ID.

method.name: phase_recording
method.description: Await to receive a [SteamTimelinePhaseResult] for the exact stable phase ID.

method.name: recording_exists
method.description: Await to receive a [SteamBoolResult] with whether Steam has video for the completed event.

method.name: recording_operation
method.description: Starts the same lookup as [method recording_exists] and returns a retained, cancellable operation.

method.name: remove_event
method.description: Removes a completed event or discards an open range owned by this service. Invalidates the handle.

method.name: set_game_mode
method.description: Sets the activity mode for the process timeline.

method.name: set_phase_attribute
method.description: Replaces an attribute on the current phase owned by this facade. Group and value are nonempty. Priority ranges from 0 through 1000.

method.name: set_tooltip
method.description: Sets a nonempty localized tooltip of up to 1024 UTF-8 bytes at a relative time in seconds.

method.name: start_phase
method.description: Starts the process phase using a stable, nonempty game ID of up to 63 UTF-8 bytes with no ASCII control characters. An already-open phase returns [constant ERR_BUSY].

method.name: start_range
method.description: Starts an open range. End it with [method end_range] or discard it with [method remove_event].

method.name: update_range
method.description: Replaces the display details of an open range owned by this service. Null presentation selects the default details.
